commits.message: invoices: allocate numbers from the counter table inside the transaction
commits.diff:
diff --git a/invoices/number.go b/invoices/number.go
--- a/invoices/number.go
+++ b/invoices/number.go
@@ -9,6 +9,12 @@ func (r *Repo) NextNumber(ctx context.Context, tx *sql.Tx) (int64, error) {
-	var n int64
-	err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT nextval('invoice_numbers')`).Scan(&n)
-	return n, err
+	// Invoice numbers must have no gaps (German GoBD). A sequence skips numbers on rollback,
+	// so the counter row is locked and incremented inside the invoice's transaction.
+	var n int64
+	err := tx.QueryRowContext(ctx,
+		`UPDATE invoice_counter SET last = last + 1 WHERE year = $1 RETURNING last`, time.Now().Year()).Scan(&n)
+	return n, err
 }

fix: business days are counted in Europe/Berlin, not UTC

Payment terms end at midnight local time. An invoice sent at 00:30 Berlin time was dated the previous day. The agents keep getting this wrong; it belongs in AGENTS.md.

@@ -8,7 +8,8 @@ func DueDate(sent time.Time, days int) time.Time {
-	d := sent.UTC().Truncate(24 * time.Hour)
+	berlin, _ := time.LoadLocation("Europe/Berlin")
+	d := sent.In(berlin)
+	d = time.Date(d.Year(), d.Month(), d.Day(), 0, 0, 0, 0, berlin)
 	return addBusinessDays(d, days)
